name: Parking & License Committee Special Agenda
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  November 02, 2023

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833,
meeting ID: 894 1979 5014 and Password 272252 on November 02, 2023 at 10:02 am.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reginald Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services & Public Safety

  Staff Present:  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Mayra Toro, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Robert Van Leer DBA Walls Annenberg Center to host a little Amal – Queen of
  Monarchs Event at 3900 W. Manchester Blvd. – KIA Forum Parking Lot; Private
  Property, on Friday, November 03, 2023, from 10:30 am – 11:30 am APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS; Applicant to
  hire adequate Forum Security for public safety; Watch Commander will be notified
  for extra patrol; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event
  shall follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing
  safety guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health
  department; and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00364934).
Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
